title: Final Pareto frontier (replaces E021)
question: What picture 'RM vs Q2 gain' do we get with equal tuning, and what of it is proven?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation

confirmed.note: E025 only S3 (5 seeds x 200k), E026 confirm, E027 S3, E030 S2 enter through min_seeds/min_steps; E028 a_long is 400k

fill.rule: levels without a confirmed point: Kerr one_hidden w31 with h = round(level / 135), recipe of the nearest width; at most 10 configurations

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.dominance: A dominates B if RM_A <= RM_B and Q2_A - Q2_B >= 0.1 dB with non-overlapping min-max intervals
rule_draft.selection: points and envelope chosen by validation; nothing is selected by test
